[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:Temple of Grenth statue.jpg|200px]] | pic3-text = Statue of Grenth | ingame name=Lornar's Pass | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=090 }} Those wishing to travel from [[Beacon's Perch]] to [[Droknar's Forge]] must brave the treacherous [[Lornar's Pass]]. This cold, remote mountain pass is home to several tribes of [[Avicara]] [[Tengu]], [[Grawl]], and [[Troll]]s, but the real danger to travelers are the giant [[Frost Wurm]]s that attack without warning in the narrow passes. A [[statue]] of [[Grenth]] stands at the southern end of Lornar's Pass, from which players can gain access to [[the Underworld]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Nord Stonegrimm]] ([[collector]] of 2 [[Frozen Shell]]s) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 [[Black Bear]] *{{x}} 5 [[Snow Wolf]] ===Foes=== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) * {{w}} 9 (23) [[Summit Axe Wielder]] * {{w}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Crusher]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Ranger]] * {{r}} 9 (23) [[Stone Summit Scout]] * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Dolyak Master]] * {{mo}} 11 (24) [[Dolyak Rider]] * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Gnasher]] * {{n}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Howler]] * {{me}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Heretic]] * {{me}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Sage]] [[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) * {{e}} 10 (24) [[Ice Golem]] * {{e}} 24 (26) [[Siege Ice Golem]] [[Grawl]]s * {{w}} 22 (26) [[Grawl (Shiverpeaks)|Grawl]] * {{n}} 22 (26) [[Grawl Crone]] [[Imp]]s * {{e}} 22 (26) [[Ice Imp]] [[Plant]]s * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Pinesoul]] [[Tengu]] (Avicara) * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Brave]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Fierce]] * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Ardent]] * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Guile]] [[Troll]]s * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Mountain Troll]] [[Wurm]]s * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Frost Wurm]] ====Bosses==== Dwarves (Stone Summit) * {{n}} 28 (30) [[Tonfor Copperblood]] → [[Offering of Blood]] * {{me}} 28 (30) [[Erzek Runebreaker]] → [[Crippling Anguish]] Elementals (Stone Summit) * {{e}} 28 (30) [[Chunk Clumpfoot]] → [[Water Trident]] Plants * {{w}} 28 (30) [[Clobberhusk]] → [[Defy Pain]] * {{r}} 28 (30) [[Poisonbough]] * {{mo}} 28 (30) [[Quickroot]] → [[Life Barrier]] Wurms * {{n}} 28 (30) [[Maw the Mountain Heart]] → [[Feast of Corruption]] (doesn't always [[spawn]]) ==Landmarks== [[Temple of Grenth]] - This is the only existing entrance to the Underworld in an explorable area. A Statue of Grenth can be found in this area. More specifically, the architecture surrounding it suggests it may be a temple to the God of Death. Kneeling at the statue will call forth a [[Voice of Grenth]] that will provide blessings for a fee. ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.6% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 286|low = 270|high = 301}} **The main difficulty is the Stone Summit in a fort on the eastern side of the map. Two particularly large groups are located there, one of which contains two Dolyak Masters and one Dolyak Rider. See the [[Talk:Lornar's Pass|talk page]] for discussion and tips on how to defeat this mob. **It is recommended to start from [[Camp Rankor]] and vanquish [[Snake Dance]] and Dreadnought's Drift along the way. While this takes a while, you have a [[party]] of 8, making it easier than starting from Beacon's Perch. **The Grawl Crones use [[Verata's Aura]] - make sure you have a way to deal with this if your party includes a [[minion master]]. **The hidden Frost Wurms are mostly along the path that circles the frozen lake as well as north of the tunnel that connects to that path. *In [[normal mode]], if you enter this area from Beacon's Perch, you will need [[hero]]es instead of [[henchmen]], because the latter are too low level compared to the foes here. *When trying to enter the Underworld at the Temple of Grenth, you will be unable to enter with henchmen as they are not [[Ascended]]. Likewise if your [[character]] is not Ascended, or achieved the [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] ([[Weh no Su]]) or [[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]] ([[Hunted!]]) equivalents, your character cannot enter. {{anomaly|When you enter the area from Beacon's Perch, the gate back in is closed; however, you can still walk through it.}} == Trivia == {{gw2w}} * [[Lornar]] is the hero who single-handedly held-off a [[Hill Giant]] invasion at Beacon's Perch in [[Timeline|534 AE]]. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} {{Research needed| Notes section:"unable to enter with henchmen". Needs clarification: are the henchmen and non-Ascended players kicked out of the party and left in Lornar's Pass when you enter UW or are you not allowed to enter if you have henchmen or non-Ascended players in your party? }} [[de:Lornarpass]]
